Complaint.title: Complaint
Complaint.description: A citizen complaint reporting a shop or syndicate selling gas cylinders at inflated prices.

shopName.description: Name of the retail gas cylinder shop or distributor.

shopAddress.description: Full street address or location of the shop.

district.description: District, city, or municipal region of the shop.

cylinderBrand.description: Brand of the gas cylinder (e.g. Bashundhara, Omera, Jamuna, Beximco, Total, BM, etc.).

govtPrice.description: Official government fixed price or recommended retail price in currency.

sellingPrice.description: Actual inflated selling price demanded by the shop.

markupAmount.description: Excess markup amount imposed by the syndicate (sellingPrice - govtPrice).

syndicateTactic.description: Syndicate tactic observed (e.g., artificial shortage, hidden stock, receipt refusal, cartel fixing).

evidencePhotoUrl.description: Photo evidence of the shop signboard, cylinder stock, or price board.

userId.description: Google UID of the reporting user.

userName.description: Public display name of the reporting user from their Google account.

userEmail.description: Verified Gmail address of the reporting user.

status.description: Current status of the complaint report.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the complaint was submitted.

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp exactly 15 days after submission when complaint expires.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stored user profile holding only user's Gmail address and name for 15-day session tracking.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of most recent Google login.

sessionExpiresAt.description: 15-day expiration timestamp for the user session.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Platform administrator who can check all complaint posts with user Gmail & names and remove/moderate posts.

/complaints/{complaintId}.description: Citizen reports of gas cylinder price gouging and syndicate markups.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile containing only Gmail address and name.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Platform administrator accounts authorized to moderate complaints.
